GeneratingUnit


A single or set of synchronous machines for converting mechanical power into alternating-current power. For example, individual machines within a set may be defined for scheduling purposes while a single control signal is derived for the set. In this case there would be a GeneratingUnit for each member of the set and an additional GeneratingUnit corresponding to the set.

  • GeneratingUnit
  • HydroGeneratingUnit
  • SolarGeneratingUnit
  • NuclearGeneratingUnit
  • WindGeneratingUnit
  • ThermalGeneratingUnit
root anyOf GeneratingUnit

GeneratingUnit

Type: object

A single or set of synchronous machines for converting mechanical power into alternating-current power. For example, individual machines within a set may be defined for scheduling purposes while a single control signal is derived for the set. In this case there would be a GeneratingUnit for each member of the set and an additional GeneratingUnit corresponding to the set.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

 No Additional Items

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves GenUnitOpCostCurve

GenUnitOpCostCurve

Type: object

Relationship between unit operating cost (Y-axis) and unit output active power (X-axis). The operating cost curve for thermal units is derived from heat input and fuel costs. The operating cost curve for hydro units is derived from water flow rates and equivalent water costs.

 No Additional Properties

isNetGrossP

Type: boolean

Flag is set to true when output is expressed in net active power.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves GenUnitOpCostCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves GenUnitOpCostCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD unit

Type: object or number

The attribute shall be a positive value equal to or less than RotatingMachine.ratedS.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.raiseRampRate

raiseRampRate

Type: object or number

The normal maximum rate the generating unit active power output can be raised by control actions.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

root anyOf GeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.allocSpinResP

allocSpinResP

The planned unused capacity (spinning reserve) which can be used to support emergency load.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

  • "GeneratorControlMode.pulse"

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.genControlSource

genControlSource

  • "GeneratorControlSource.unavailable"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.offAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.plantControl"
root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit

HydroGeneratingUnit

Type: object

A generating unit whose prime mover is a hydraulic turbine (e.g., Francis, Pelton, Kaplan).

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpCostCurveArray

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.raiseRampRate

raiseRampRate

Type: object or number

The normal maximum rate the generating unit active power output can be raised by control actions.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

cimObjectType

Must be one of:

  • "HydroGeneratingUnit"

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.genControlMode

genControlMode

Type: enum (of string)

The unit control mode.

Must be one of:

  • "GeneratorControlMode.setpoint"
  • "GeneratorControlMode.pulse"

root anyOf HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.genControlSource

genControlSource

Type: enum (of string)

The source of controls for a generating unit. Defines the control status of the generating unit.

Must be one of:

  • "GeneratorControlSource.onAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.unavailable"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.offAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.plantControl"
root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit

SolarGeneratingUnit

Type: object

A solar thermal generating unit, connected to the grid by means of a rotating machine. This class does not represent photovoltaic (PV) generation.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

GenUnitOpCostCurveArray

Type: array

Array of GenUnitOpCostCurve objects

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

The attribute shall be a positive value equal to or less than RotatingMachine.ratedS.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.raiseRampRate

raiseRampRate

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

totalEfficiency

Type: object or number

The efficiency of the unit in converting the fuel into electrical energy.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.baseP

baseP

Type: object or number

For dispatchable units, this value represents the economic active power basepoint, for units that are not dispatchable, this value represents the fixed generation value. The value shall be between the operating low and high limits.

root anyOf SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit

NuclearGeneratingUnit

Type: object

A nuclear generating unit.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

GenUnitOpCostCurveArray

Type: array

Array of GenUnitOpCostCurve objects

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD unit

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.raiseRampRate

raiseRampRate

Type: object or number

The normal maximum rate the generating unit active power output can be raised by control actions.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.totalEfficiency

totalEfficiency

Type: object or number

The efficiency of the unit in converting the fuel into electrical energy.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Unit control error deadband. When a unit's desired active power change is less than this deadband, then no control pulses will be sent to the unit.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.genControlMode

genControlMode

Type: enum (of string)

The unit control mode.

Must be one of:

  • "GeneratorControlMode.setpoint"
  • "GeneratorControlMode.pulse"

root anyOf NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.genControlSource

genControlSource

Type: enum (of string)

The source of controls for a generating unit. Defines the control status of the generating unit.

Must be one of:

  • "GeneratorControlSource.onAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.unavailable"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.offAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.plantControl"
root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit

WindGeneratingUnit

Type: object

A wind driven generating unit, connected to the grid by means of a rotating machine. May be used to represent a single turbine or an aggregation.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

GenUnitOpCostCurveArray

Type: array

Array of GenUnitOpCostCurve objects

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

The attribute shall be a positive value equal to or less than RotatingMachine.ratedS.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.raiseRampRate

raiseRampRate

Type: object or number

The normal maximum rate the generating unit active power output can be raised by control actions.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.totalEfficiency

totalEfficiency

Type: object or number

The efficiency of the unit in converting the fuel into electrical energy.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit WindGeneratingUnit.windGenUnitType

windGenUnitType

Type: enum (of string)

The kind of wind generating unit.

Must be one of:

  • "WindGenUnitKind.onshore"
  • "WindGenUnitKind.offshore"

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root anyOf WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit

ThermalGeneratingUnit

Type: object

A generating unit whose prime mover could be a steam turbine, combustion turbine, or diesel engine.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

GenUnitOpCostCurveArray

Array of GenUnitOpCostCurve objects

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpCostCurves

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root anyOf GeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD unit

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.raiseRampRate

raiseRampRate

Type: object or number

The normal maximum rate the generating unit active power output can be raised by control actions.

description

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

totalEfficiency

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf ThermalGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.
